chunks: "Excellent is the south wind: it breaks the cold from the needy, pollinates the trees, and causes the valleys to flow."

key_terms.اَلرِّيحُ: the wind, as a created force bringing benefit

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the blessing of the south wind?
ai.summary: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام praises the south wind for the benefits Allah places in it for creation. The hadith highlights its mercy toward the poor, its role in pollinating trees, and its effect in bringing water through the valleys.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1523 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"The south wind (al-janub) is a blessing; it breaks the cold for the needy, pollinates the trees, and fills the valleys with water”.
